etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 重 'heavy' (phonetic シュ) — the heaviest grains kept for sowing: seed; each seed its kind: species.
mnemonic: The fattest seeds go in the sowing jar, sorted by kind — たね. 種類: the jars, labeled.

etymology: Pictograph: a field planted thick to its borders — covering all the way around: circumference, circuit.
mnemonic: Plow to every edge, then walk the fence line — シュウ. 一周: one full lap of anything.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the speaker (兄, a mouth on legs) at the altar (ネ) — reciting the blessing: to celebrate.
mnemonic: The family's voice steps up to the altar with good news — いわう. お祝い: the blessing plus an envelope.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a head (頁) following the stream (川) — going with the current: obedient; the sequence the current makes: order.
mnemonic: Float head-first the way the river says — ジュン. 順番: the river arranging everyone into a queue.

etymology: Compound ideograph: cloth (衤) + blade (刀) — the tailor's first cut into new fabric: the very beginning.
mnemonic: Scissors poised over untouched cloth: no undo after this — はじめて. 最初 is that cut; 初めまして its social version.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 尭 'raised high' (phonetic ショウ) — flames piled high: to burn, grill, bake.
mnemonic: Stack the fire and put dinner over it — やく. 焼き鳥, 焼きそば, お好み焼き: Japan's tastiest kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 昭 'shining' (phonetic ショウ) + fire (灬) — light cast down onto: to illuminate.
mnemonic: Floodlights plus footlights: everything visible — てる. 照れる is being lit up when you'd rather not be: blushing.

etymology: Compound ideograph: narrowing (少) the eye (目) — close inspection: to reflect (反省); to trim what inspection finds useless: omit; the inspecting office: ministry.
mnemonic: Squint hard at it: examine, then cut the excess — かえりみる, はぶく. The 省 ministries were born squinting at budgets.

etymology: Classically read: bamboo (⺮) swaying like a person doubled over (夭) — the whole grove shaking: to laugh.
mnemonic: Wind hits the grove and every stalk cracks up — わらう. 笑顔: the face doing what bamboo does.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 成 'completed' (phonetic ジョウ) — earthworks raised to completion: a castle.
mnemonic: Dirt piled until it becomes (成) power — しろ. 大阪城: the hill that means business.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (亻) standing by their word (言) — word and person aligned: trust, faith; a message so backed.
mnemonic: Where the person and the promise overlap — シン. 信じる is betting on that overlap; 自信 betting on your own.

etymology: Pictograph: an eye turned down in a bowed head — the posture of service: retainer, minister.
mnemonic: The eye that never meets the throne's — シン. 大臣: the deepest bow with the biggest office.

etymology: Compound: work driven to its end under the halberd's authority — brought to completion: to become, to accomplish.
mnemonic: The final nail goes in and the thing exists — なる. 成功 is the nail landing; 成る the moment before.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 青 'blue-green' (phonetic セイ) — water so clean it shows blue: pure, clear.
mnemonic: Water you can read a book through — きよい. 清水寺: the temple named for exactly that spring.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 青 (phonetic セイ) + 争 'struggle' — the struggle settled into blue calm: quiet, still.
mnemonic: The fight ends and blue silence pours back in — しずか. 静かに: what the librarian's whole body says.

etymology: Compound: a cloth mat (巾) spread under the canopy (广) — one's place on the matting: a seat.
mnemonic: Your square of cloth in the pavilion: reserved — セキ. 出席 is putting your body on it; 欠席 leaving it cold.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 責 'levy' (phonetic セキ) — the tax-grain stacked sack on sack: to pile up; the pile measured: volume, product.
mnemonic: Sacks climbing the granary wall, tallied as they rise — つむ. 積極的: piling effort the same way.

etymology: Compound ideograph: hand (扌) + axe (斤) — snapping green wood over the knee or blade: to break; the gentler bend: to fold.
mnemonic: Crease it like the axe would cut it — おる. 折り紙 folds paper; 骨折 folds what shouldn't fold.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 即 (phonetic セツ) — the bamboo's joints: nodes; the year's joints: seasons; joints hold things in check: moderation.
mnemonic: Bamboo grows in verses with a knuckle between each — ふし. 季節 are the year's knuckles; 節約 is gripping at one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 単 (phonetic セン — originally a forked hunting weapon) + 戈 'halberd' — weapons against weapons: war.
mnemonic: Two arsenals in one character, nothing else in it — たたかう. 戦争 doubles the word; history keeps doubling the kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 戔 'pared down' (phonetic セン) — water shaved thin: shallow.
mnemonic: Blades planed the river down to ankle depth — あさい. 浅草: the 'shallow grass' district, deep only in crowds.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 巽 (phonetic セン) — candidates presented and one sent forward: to select, elect.
mnemonic: The line walks past; you point at one — えらぶ. 選手 is the chosen athlete; 選挙 the national pointing.

etymology: Originally 'to burn' (meat + dog + fire — the root of 燃); borrowed since antiquity for 'thus, so, in that manner'.
mnemonic: The fire says: that's just how it is — ゼン. 自然 is the world being so by itself; 全然 is 'not so at all'.

etymology: Compound ideograph: two hands wrenching one hooked object in opposite directions — to contend, dispute.
mnemonic: Both grips on the same handle, neither letting go — あらそう. 戦争 is this kanji armed; 競争 this kanji in sneakers.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 則 (phonetic ソク) — the person stationed beside: the side, the flank.
mnemonic: Always at your elbow, by the rules — がわ. 右側, 向こう側: pick your flank.

etymology: Pictograph: sticks cinched with a band around the middle — a bundle, a sheaf.
mnemonic: Firewood strapped tight through the waist — たば. 約束 ties two people the same way: a promise.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 續): thread (糸) + a phonetic now written 売 — thread joined to thread without end: to continue.
mnemonic: Splice the new spool to the old before it runs out — つづく. Every cliffhanger ends with this kanji: 続く.

etymology: Originally the marked garment of conscript soldiers — the lowest rank; serving one's full term gave 'to finish': graduation.
mnemonic: Uniforms in rows, the term served out — ソツ. 卒業 is handing the uniform back with a diploma.

etymology: Compound ideograph: child (子) + connecting thread (系) — the child one thread further down the line: grandchild.
mnemonic: Your child's child, one more knot along the family rope — まご. The thread does the explaining.

etymology: Pictograph: a sash with ornaments hanging over the skirt cloth — the belt; what a belt does: to carry on one; a belt of territory: zone.
mnemonic: The obi cinched, charms dangling — おび. 熱帯 is the planet's hot waistband; 携帯 what you carry tucked in yours.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 羍 (phonetic タツ — a lamb delivered without difficulty) — arriving without obstruction: to attain, reach.
mnemonic: Delivery without a single snag — タツ. 友達: the people your road reliably reaches; 配達: the parcel version.

etymology: Simplified from 單: a forked hunting weapon or shield — one piece of equipment, one man: single, simple.
mnemonic: One tool, no attachments — タン. 簡単 is the two-kanji hymn to it; 単語: words taken one at a time.

etymology: Phono-semantic: net (罒) + 直 'straight' (phonetic チ) — the net set out straight and left: to place, to set down.
mnemonic: Lay it flat, square it, walk away — おく. 位置: where things got 置いた and stayed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 中 'middle' (phonetic チュウ) — the person in the middle of two others: go-between; the state between people: terms.
mnemonic: Standing exactly between two friends, keeping them friends — なか. 仲がいい: the middle is warm.

etymology: Pictograph: the cracks radiating across a heated tortoise shell — read by diviners as signs: portent; borrowed for the enormous number 10¹².
mnemonic: The shell splits into a map of the future — きざし. Big enough news to need the number: 一兆.

etymology: Phono-semantic: building (广) + 氐 'base' (phonetic テイ) — the building's lowest point: the bottom.
mnemonic: Below the floor, below the footing: the true floor — そこ. 海底: the one basement the planet has.

etymology: Phono-semantic: white (白) + 勺 (phonetic テキ) — the white disc of the target: bullseye; grammaticalized into the adjective-making suffix 〜的.
mnemonic: The white circle everything aims at — まと. Attach 〜的 and any noun starts aiming: 目的, 具体的.

etymology: Simplified from 傳: person (亻) + a phonetic — the relay rider passing the message on: to transmit, hand down.
mnemonic: One person breathes it (云) to the next — つたえる. 手伝う: passing your hands along too.

etymology: Compound: road (彳) + going (走) — traveling on foot; those who walk behind a master: followers, students.
mnemonic: No horse, no cart: the ones walking behind — ト. 生徒: students, still on foot behind the teacher.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 奴 'slave' (phonetic ド) + strength (力) — working like one owned: to strive, exert.
mnemonic: Muscle spent as if you had no choice — つとめる. 努力: choosing that grind voluntarily.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 燈): fire (火) + 丁 (phonetic トウ) — fire fixed on a stand: the lamp.
mnemonic: A flame nailed in place so it can't wander — ひ, トウ. 電灯: the nail is now a socket.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 埶 (phonetic ネツ) + fire (灬) — fire tended below: heat; the body's own fire: fever.
mnemonic: Flames under everything you care about — あつい. 熱がある: the fire moved indoors; 熱心: the useful kind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 今 'now' (phonetic ネン) + heart (心) — the heart holding this very moment: a fixed thought, a wish.
mnemonic: The heart pressing 'save' on the present — ネン. 残念: the save that failed; 記念: the one that took.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 'treasure' (phonetic ハイ) + 攵 'strike' — the treasure smashed: ruin, defeat.
mnemonic: The stick comes down on the shell: what you built, broken — やぶれる. 失敗 pairs losing grip with the crack.
